3270 Nerd Font.description: Recreation of the IBM 3270 terminal font (1971) with Nerd Font glyphs. The original was used on IBM mainframe display terminals for decades. This modern TrueType version was hand-traced from actual 3270 hardware by Ricardo Bánffy via Georgia Tech's 3270tool and the x3270 emulator.
3270 Nerd Font.known_for: Nostalgic mainframe aesthetic, wide readable glyphs, bitmap-influenced design
3270 Nerd Font.creator: Ricardo Bánffy (3270font), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

Andale Mono.description: Monospaced sans-serif originally designed for the Taligent project (Apple/IBM joint venture) and later distributed as part of Microsoft's Core Fonts for the Web. First shipped as 'Monotype.com' with IE4, renamed to Andale Mono with IE5. Now bundled with macOS. Same designer as Droid Sans Mono.
Andale Mono.known_for: Clean narrow design, excellent screen rendering, clear l/1/I distinction, one of the earliest web-safe monospaced fonts
Andale Mono.creator: Steve Matteson (Monotype/Ascender)

CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched version of Microsoft's Cascadia Code, the default font for Windows Terminal. Features programming ligatures and a cursive italic variant (activatable via OpenType ss01). Named 'CaskaydiaCove' due to Nerd Fonts naming restrictions; the official Cascadia Code NF now exists separately from Microsoft.
CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font.known_for: Programming ligatures, cursive italic variant via ss01, designed specifically for terminal use, Windows Terminal default
CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font.creator: Aaron Bell (Microsoft), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

ComicMonoNF.description: Nerd Font-patched Comic Mono by Thai Pangsakulyanont (dtinth). A monospaced adaptation of Shannon Miwa's Comic Shanns v1 — all glyphs adjusted to equal width using monospacifier. Part of the Comic Sans-inspired font family tree. Sibling to ComicShannsMono (based on v2) and predecessor to SeriousShanns (legibility fork).
ComicMonoNF.known_for: Comic Sans aesthetic in a proper monospace format, fun casual coding, all glyphs equal width based on Cousine metrics
ComicMonoNF.creator: Thai Pangsakulyanont (Comic Mono), Shannon Miwa (Comic Shanns v1)

ComicShannsMono Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Comic Shanns Mono by Jesús González — a monospaced adaptation of Shannon Miwa's Comic Shanns v2 (the updated version). Different lineage from Comic Mono (which is based on v1). The Nerd Fonts version includes a manually-added Bold weight inspired by Comic Mono, plus corrected caron/dcaron/tcaron glyphs.
ComicShannsMono Nerd Font.known_for: Comic Sans v2 aesthetic with proper monospacing, more refined glyphs than v1-based Comic Mono, playful coding
ComicShannsMono Nerd Font.lineage: Comic Sans → Comic Shanns v2 (Miwa) → Comic Shanns Mono (jesusmgg) → ComicShannsMono Nerd Font
ComicShannsMono Nerd Font.creator: Jesús González (Comic Shanns Mono), Shannon Miwa (Comic Shanns v2), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

SeriousShanns Nerd Font Mono.description: Nerd Font-patched Serious Shanns — a legibility-focused fork of Comic Mono (which is based on Comic Shanns v1). Created by kaBeech after discovering Comic Mono improved their coding mindset. Key changes: 'a' redesigned to not look like 'o', 'l' distinguished from '1', 'Y' distinguished from 'y'. Adds Light weight and Italic styles not present in Comic Mono.
SeriousShanns Nerd Font Mono.known_for: Best-in-class character disambiguation among Comic Sans-inspired fonts, 'a'/'o' fix, 'l'/'1' fix, 'Y'/'y' fix, Light weight + Italics
SeriousShanns Nerd Font Mono.lineage: Comic Sans → Comic Shanns v1 (Miwa) → Comic Mono (dtinth) → Serious Shanns (kaBeech) → SeriousShanns Nerd Font Mono
SeriousShanns Nerd Font Mono.creator: kaBeech (Serious Shanns), Thai Pangsakulyanont (Comic Mono), Shannon Miwa (Comic Shanns v1)

CommitMono.description: Neutral programming typeface by Eigil Nikolajsen. Distinctive 'smart kerning' adjusts letter spacing based on neighboring character widths to improve word-shape recognition and reading speed. Ligatures are included but off by default, and only functional ones (e.g., != → ≠) — no purely aesthetic ligatures.
CommitMono.known_for: Smart kerning for improved readability, neutral anonymous aesthetic, functional-only ligatures (off by default)
CommitMono.creator: Eigil Nikolajsen

CommitMonoV143.description: CommitMono version 1.43 — a pinned earlier release kept for comparison or preference. Same design philosophy as CommitMono but prior to later refinements.
CommitMonoV143.known_for: Specific pinned version of CommitMono with smart kerning and neutral aesthetic
CommitMonoV143.creator: Eigil Nikolajsen

DroidSansM Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Droid Sans Mono — the monospaced member of the Droid typeface family, commissioned by Google for Android in 2006. Designed for screen legibility on mobile devices. Same designer as Andale Mono. Features upright stress, open forms, and a neutral appearance optimized for UI text.
DroidSansM Nerd Font.known_for: Android's original monospaced font, mobile-optimized legibility, clean neutral design, slashed zero
DroidSansM Nerd Font.creator: Steve Matteson and Terrance Weinzierl (Ascender Corp for Google), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

FiraCode Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Fira Code — the most popular programming font with ligatures. Extended from Mozilla's Fira Mono (designed for Firefox OS). Renders multi-character operators as single glyphs (=>, !==, <=>, ->>, etc.) for visual clarity. Over 140 programming ligatures.
FiraCode Nerd Font.known_for: Industry-standard programming ligatures (=>, <=, !=, etc.), based on Mozilla's Fira Mono, most popular ligature font on GitHub
FiraCode Nerd Font.creator: Nikita Prokopov (Fira Code), Ralph du Carrois (Fira Mono for Mozilla), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

Fira Code iScript.description: A mashup font combining Fira Code (Regular/Bold) with Script12 (Italic). Uses Fira Code's programming ligatures for normal text, but switches to a cursive handwriting style wherever italics appear — comments, keywords, etc. depending on editor theme.
Fira Code iScript.known_for: Fira Code ligatures + cursive Script12 italics, popular with VS Code themes that italicize keywords/comments
Fira Code iScript.creator: Ken Crocken (mashup), Nikita Prokopov (Fira Code)

Hack Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Hack — a typeface designed specifically for source code, evolved from Bitstream Vera Sans Mono (2003) via DejaVu Sans Mono. Redesigned glyph set with over 1,500 characters, optimized for 8-14px sizes. Large x-height with wide apertures and low contrast for screen legibility. Default monospace font for KDE on openSUSE.
Hack Nerd Font.known_for: Bitstream Vera/DejaVu lineage refined for code, large x-height, wide apertures, sweet spot at 8-14px, 1,500+ glyphs
Hack Nerd Font.lineage: Bitstream Vera Sans Mono (2003) → DejaVu Sans Mono → Hack (2015)
Hack Nerd Font.creator: Chris Simpkins (Hack), Jim Lyles (Bitstream Vera), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

Intel One Mono.description: Monospaced font designed with input from low-vision and legally blind developers through dozens of live testing sessions. Character differentiation is maximized — sloped stems on 'M' (vs 'N'), exaggerated braces/brackets/parens, maximized height differences between upper and lowercase. Won Fast Company Innovation by Design 2024 award.
Intel One Mono.known_for: Accessibility-first design, tested with low-vision developers, exaggerated character differentiation, 4 weights + italics, ligatures via ss01
Intel One Mono.creator: Intel Corporation with Frere-Jones Type and VML

Iosevka.description: Ultra-customizable monospace typeface with ~143 configurable characters and 19 stylistic sets. Notably narrow/slender compared to most monospace fonts, allowing more columns on screen. Built from code — users can create custom variants via build plans. Provides sans-serif and slab-serif variants across 3 spacing modes.
Iosevka.known_for: Extremely narrow/space-efficient, built-from-code customization system, ~100 prebuilt variants, 9 weights from Thin to Heavy
Iosevka.creator: Belleve Invis

Iosevka Fixed.description: Iosevka variant with ligatures disabled for better compatibility in environments that don't handle ligatures well (some terminals, editors). Same narrow spacing as default Iosevka.
Iosevka Fixed.known_for: Iosevka without ligatures — guaranteed single-glyph-per-character for strict monospace environments
Iosevka Fixed.creator: Belleve Invis

Iosevka Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Iosevka with dev tool icons. Retains Iosevka's signature narrow design for maximum columns on screen.
Iosevka Nerd Font.known_for: Iosevka's space efficiency + Nerd Font dev icons
Iosevka Nerd Font.creator: Belleve Invis (font), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

Iosevka Slab.description: Iosevka with slab serifs — small horizontal strokes at the ends of letterforms. The serifs aid readability at small sizes and give a more traditional 'typewriter' feel while keeping Iosevka's narrow spacing.
Iosevka Slab.known_for: Iosevka's space efficiency with slab serifs for improved small-size readability
Iosevka Slab.creator: Belleve Invis

Iosevka Term.description: Iosevka variant where symbols are narrowed to fit terminal column-counting conventions. Unlike default Iosevka where some symbols may be wider, Term forces everything into strict terminal-width columns.
Iosevka Term.known_for: Terminal-strict column widths — symbols narrowed to match terminal ideology
Iosevka Term.creator: Belleve Invis

Iosevka Term Slab.description: Combines Iosevka Term's terminal-strict column widths with slab serifs. Best of both: strict monospace metrics for terminals plus serif readability aids.
Iosevka Term Slab.creator: Belleve Invis

JetBrainsMono Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched JetBrains Mono — designed by JetBrains for their IDEs. Features 140+ programming ligatures and an increased x-height for better readability at smaller sizes. Functional ligatures only — arrow and operator combinations, not decorative.
JetBrainsMono Nerd Font.known_for: 140+ functional ligatures, increased x-height, designed for IDE use, very popular among JetBrains IDE users
JetBrainsMono Nerd Font.creator: Philipp Nurullin and Konstantin Bulenkov (JetBrains), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

JetBrainsMonoNL Nerd Font.description: JetBrains Mono 'No Ligatures' variant with Nerd Font glyphs. Same design as JetBrains Mono but with all programming ligatures removed — for developers who prefer seeing individual characters.
JetBrainsMonoNL Nerd Font.known_for: JetBrains Mono design without ligatures, for developers who want explicit character visibility
JetBrainsMonoNL Nerd Font.creator: Philipp Nurullin and Konstantin Bulenkov (JetBrains), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MesloLGL Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Meslo LG L (Large line gap). Meslo is a customized Apple Menlo with adjusted vertical spacing and a tweaked asterisk. LGL = Large line gap — the most spacious of the three variants. Menlo itself derives from Bitstream Vera Sans Mono → DejaVu Sans Mono.
MesloLGL Nerd Font.known_for: Menlo with large line gap — most vertical breathing room of the Meslo variants
MesloLGL Nerd Font.lineage: Bitstream Vera Sans Mono → DejaVu Sans Mono → Menlo (Apple) → Meslo LG (André Berg)
MesloLGL Nerd Font.creator: André Berg (Meslo), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MesloLGLDZ Nerd Font.description: Meslo LG L with Dotted Zero — large line gap variant where the zero has a center dot instead of a slash, making 0/O distinction clearer in a different way.
MesloLGLDZ Nerd Font.known_for: Large line gap + dotted zero for 0/O distinction
MesloLGLDZ Nerd Font.creator: André Berg (Meslo), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MesloLGM Nerd Font.description: Meslo LG M (Medium line gap) with Nerd Font patches. The middle-ground Meslo variant — less spacious than LGL, more than LGS.
MesloLGM Nerd Font.known_for: Menlo with medium line gap — balanced vertical spacing
MesloLGM Nerd Font.creator: André Berg (Meslo), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font.description: Meslo LG M with Dotted Zero — medium line gap variant with center-dot zero.
MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font.known_for: Medium line gap + dotted zero for 0/O distinction
MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font.creator: André Berg (Meslo), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MesloLGS Nerd Font.description: Meslo LG S (Small line gap) with Nerd Font patches. The most compact Meslo variant — minimal vertical spacing for maximum lines on screen. Popular with Powerlevel10k Zsh theme.
MesloLGS Nerd Font.known_for: Menlo with small line gap — most compact, recommended by Powerlevel10k
MesloLGS Nerd Font.creator: André Berg (Meslo), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MesloLGSDZ Nerd Font.description: Meslo LG S with Dotted Zero — small line gap variant with center-dot zero.
MesloLGSDZ Nerd Font.known_for: Small line gap + dotted zero for 0/O distinction
MesloLGSDZ Nerd Font.creator: André Berg (Meslo), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MonaspiceAr Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Monaspace Argon — the humanist sans-serif member of GitHub's Monaspace superfamily. Friendly and organic with smooth curves. All 5 Monaspace fonts are metrics-compatible, meaning you can mix them (e.g., Argon for code, Radon for comments) in editors that support per-scope font assignment.
MonaspiceAr Nerd Font.known_for: Humanist/organic style — friendly and elegant, part of GitHub's mixable Monaspace superfamily
MonaspiceAr Nerd Font.creator: GitHub Next, Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MonaspiceKr Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Monaspace Krypton — the mechanical sans-serif member of the Monaspace superfamily. Futuristic and precise with a technical aesthetic. Metrics-compatible with Argon, Neon, Radon, and Xenon for mixing.
MonaspiceKr Nerd Font.known_for: Mechanical/futuristic style — technical and precise, part of GitHub's mixable Monaspace superfamily
MonaspiceKr Nerd Font.creator: GitHub Next, Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MonaspiceNe Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Monaspace Neon — the neo-grotesque sans-serif member of the Monaspace superfamily. Clean, modern, and minimalist with subtle warmth. The most 'normal' of the five Monaspace faces. Metrics-compatible with the other four for mixing.
MonaspiceNe Nerd Font.known_for: Neo-grotesque style — clean and modern, the 'default' Monaspace face, part of GitHub's mixable superfamily
MonaspiceNe Nerd Font.creator: GitHub Next, Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MonaspiceRn Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Monaspace Radon — the handwriting member of the Monaspace superfamily. Playful and quirky with dynamic movement. Often used as the italic/comment face when mixing Monaspace fonts. Metrics-compatible with the other four.
MonaspiceRn Nerd Font.known_for: Handwriting style — playful and dynamic, popular as italic/comment face when mixing Monaspace fonts
MonaspiceRn Nerd Font.creator: GitHub Next, Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

MonaspiceXe Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Monaspace Xenon — the slab-serif member of the Monaspace superfamily. Bold and confident with sturdy structure. Gives code an authoritative, typeset-book quality. Metrics-compatible with the other four for mixing.
MonaspiceXe Nerd Font.known_for: Slab-serif style — bold and authoritative, part of GitHub's mixable Monaspace superfamily
MonaspiceXe Nerd Font.creator: GitHub Next, Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

Nimbus Mono PS.description: URW++ Courier replacement from the Ghostscript base-35 PostScript fonts. Ships as a system font on most Linux distros and WSL. Designed to be metrically compatible with Courier — not a programming font, but a document/PostScript font. 'PS' indicates the current PostScript-era naming; earlier versions were called 'Nimbus Mono L'.
Nimbus Mono PS.known_for: Free Courier replacement, ships with Ghostscript/Linux, not designed for coding, only Regular and Bold weights
Nimbus Mono PS.creator: URW++ Design & Development GmbH

PT Mono.description: Monospaced font from ParaType's PT superfamily, originally developed for the Russian government's 'Public Types of Russian Federation' project. Designed for forms, tables, and structured documents where equal character widths matter for calculating field sizes and column alignment. Exceptional Cyrillic coverage including nearly all minority languages of the Russian Federation.
PT Mono.known_for: Pan-Cyrillic coverage (Russian Federation minority languages), designed for government forms/tables, humanist proportions
PT Mono.creator: Alexandra Korolkova with Isabella Chaeva (ParaType), funded by Google

RobotoMono Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Roboto Mono — the monospaced member of Google's Roboto family. Adapts forms for monospace constraints: narrow glyphs like 'I', 'l', 'i' gain serifs for even texture, while wide glyphs like 'C', 'O' take on straighter sides from Roboto Condensed. Five weights with matching italics.
RobotoMono Nerd Font.known_for: Google's monospace with adaptive glyph forms, mechanical skeleton + friendly curves, optimized for screens across devices
RobotoMono Nerd Font.creator: Christian Robertson (Google), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

SauceCodePro Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Source Code Pro — Adobe's first open-source font family, designed as the monospaced companion to Source Sans. Named 'SauceCodePro' due to Nerd Fonts naming restrictions. Optimized for UI environments with careful 0/O, 1/l/I disambiguation. Six weights (ExtraLight to Bold) with italics added in 2015, variable format in 2018.
SauceCodePro Nerd Font.known_for: Adobe's open-source coding font, excellent character disambiguation, 6 weights + italics, widely used as a default in editors
SauceCodePro Nerd Font.creator: Paul D. Hunt (Adobe), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

SpaceMono Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Space Mono — a 'monospace-first, monospace-only' typeface commissioned by Google from Colophon Foundry (London/LA). Combines grotesque and geometric influences, partly based on their Basis Grotesque. Designed as an editorial display face that happens to be monospaced — more typographic personality than typical coding fonts.
SpaceMono Nerd Font.known_for: Editorial/display personality unusual for a monospace, grotesque + geometric hybrid, designed for Google Fonts
SpaceMono Nerd Font.creator: Colophon Foundry (Critton, Harrington, Sheret) for Google, Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

Terminess Nerd Font.description: Nerd Font-patched Terminus — a clean fixed-width bitmap font designed for 8+ hour daily terminal use. The TrueType version preserves the bitmap aesthetic. Original supports 120+ language sets at specific pixel sizes (6x12 through 16x32). One of the few bitmap-origin fonts in common use.
Terminess Nerd Font.known_for: Bitmap-origin terminal font, designed for all-day use, crisp at native sizes without anti-aliasing, 1,356 characters covering 120+ languages
Terminess Nerd Font.creator: Dimitar Zhekov (Terminus), Ryan McIntyre (Nerd Fonts)

Victor Mono.description: Slender, crisp programming font with semi-connected cursive italics — the italics have a handwritten flow while staying readable. Seven weights (Thin to Bold) each with Regular, Italic, and Oblique styles (21 total). Large x-height with clear punctuation. Supports Cyrillic, Greek, and Vietnamese.
Victor Mono.known_for: Semi-connected cursive italics (unique among programming fonts), 7 weights x 3 styles = 21 variants, slender crisp design
Victor Mono.creator: Rune Bjørnerås
